units.source_text: 于是，舞女忽然列举了三两个女孩子的名字，开始谈了起来。

en.t: Then the dancer suddenly named two or three girls and began talking about them.
I could not make sense of it.

units.source_text: 她好像不是说大岛，而是说甲府的事。

en.t: She seemed to be talking not about Oshima, but about Kofu.

units.source_text: 又好像是说她上普通小学二年级以前的小学同学的事。

en.t: It also seemed that she was talking about classmates from before she entered the second year of ordinary elementary school.

units.source_text: 完全是东拉西扯，漫无边际。

en.t: It was completely rambling, wandering everywhere with no clear point.
